logp.method_description: The distribution coefficients (D7.4) of the compounds were determined by the shake-flask method in n-octanol/buffered aqueous solution at pH 7.40 (25.0 ± 0.2 °C). The ligand precursors and the complexes were dissolved in 10 mM HEPES presaturated with n-octanol. The aqueous solution and n-octanol (1:1 ratio) were gently mixed with a 360° vertical rotation (∼20 rpm) for 3 h; then, the samples were centrifuged at 3000 rpm for 5 min. Two phases were separated, and their UV–vis spectra were recorded. The D7.4 value was calculated as follows D7.4 = [(Absaq.stock solution / Absaq.phase after separation) - 1] × (Vaq.phase / Voct.phase)
